audit_items.proof_trace: Neither assignRole nor removeRole performs an application-level role-position check before calling Discord. However, Discord's API server-side enforcement unconditionally rejects any bot attempt to manage a role positioned above the bot's own highest role, returning a 403 that is caught in addRoleToMember/removeRoleFromMember (discord.ts:97-100) and propagated as a failure — making the constraint unbypassable from this application regardless of the requested role_id.
